project.title: สามเหลี่ยมเบอร์มิวดา มันกลืนเรือจริงไหม?

voice.style_prompt: Read aloud in a natural, playful, conversational Thai voice. Sound relaxed, confident, curious, and slightly cheeky, like a charismatic Thai creator casually sharing a fascinating mystery with a close friend. Keep the delivery flowing and connected, with a medium-fast pace and clear pronunciation. Build intrigue without sounding frightening or sensational. Use brief natural pauses only when they help comprehension. Never sound like a news presenter, announcer, advertisement, or formal narrator.

wan.prompt: Preserve the canonical Mamase anime male presenter identity, rectangular glasses, tousled black hair, maritime jacket, Thai title and composition. He speaks naturally with subtle blinking, a small concerned expression and gentle pointing gesture. Behind him, an intact cargo ship moves through rough Atlantic waves while a propeller aircraft enters a rain squall. Rain and sea spray move naturally, slow stable cinematic push-in.
